================
File: src/components/Model/Effects.js
================
 1: import React from "react";
 2: import {
 3:   EffectComposer,
 4:   Outline,
 5:   ToneMapping,
 6: } from "@react-three/postprocessing";
 7: import * as THREE from "three";
 8: const Effects = ({
 9:   selectedItems,
10:   occupiedItems,
11:   selectionColor,
12:   occupiedColor,
13: }) => {
14:   const isSelected = (name) => selectedItems.includes(name);
15:   const isOccupied = (name) => occupiedItems.includes(name);
16:   return (
17:     <EffectComposer>
18:       <Outline
19:         selection={[...selectedItems, ...occupiedItems]}
20:         edgeStrength={10}
21:         visibleEdgeColor={(obj) => {
22:           const name = obj.name;
23:           if (isSelected(name)) {
24:             return selectionColor;
25:           } else if (isOccupied(name)) {
26:             return occupiedColor;
27:           }
28:           return new THREE.Color(0x000000);
29:         }}
30:         hiddenEdgeColor={(obj) => {
31:           const name = obj.name;
32:           if (isSelected(name)) {
33:             return selectionColor;
34:           } else if (isOccupied(name)) {
35:             return occupiedColor;
36:           }
37:           return new THREE.Color(0x000000);
38:         }}
39:       />
40:       <ToneMapping />
41:     </EffectComposer>
42:   );
43: };
44: export default Effects;

================
File: src/components/Model/GenericModel.js
================
  1: import React, { useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
  2: import { useGLTF } from "@react-three/drei";
  3: import { Clock } from "three";
  4: import SelectableItem from "./SelectableItem";
  5: import Effects from "./Effects";
  6: import useDebouncedHover from "../../hooks/useDebouncedHover";
  7: export function GenericModel({
  8:   modelConfig,
  9:   selectedItems,
 10:   occupiedItems,
 11:   onItemClicked,
 12:   enableDebug = false,
 13:   ...props
 14: }) {
 15:   const { nodes, materials } = useGLTF(modelConfig.modelPath);
 16:   const groupRef = useRef();
 17:   const clock = useRef(new Clock());
 18:   const { handlePointerOver, handlePointerOut } = useDebouncedHover(30);
 19:   useEffect(() => {
 20:     if (enableDebug) {
 21:       console.log("=== MODEL DEBUG INFO ===");
 22:       console.log("Available nodes:", Object.keys(nodes));
 23:       console.log("Available materials:", Object.keys(materials));
 24:       console.log("Model config:", modelConfig);
 25:       console.log("\n=== STATIC ITEMS CHECK ===");
 26:       modelConfig.staticItems.forEach((item, index) => {
 27:         const hasGeometry = nodes[item.geometryName];
 28:         const hasMaterial = materials[item.materialName];
 29:         console.log(`Static Item ${index}: ${item.name}`);
 30:         console.log(
 31:           `  Geometry '${item.geometryName}': ${
 32:             hasGeometry ? "✓ Found" : "✗ MISSING"
 33:           }`
 34:         );
 35:         console.log(
 36:           `  Material '${item.materialName}': ${
 37:             hasMaterial ? "✓ Found" : "✗ MISSING"
 38:           }`
 39:         );
 40:         if (!hasGeometry) {
 41:           console.warn(
 42:             `Missing geometry for static item: ${item.name} -> ${item.geometryName}`
 43:           );
 44:         }
 45:         if (!hasMaterial) {
 46:           console.warn(
 47:             `Missing material for static item: ${item.name} -> ${item.materialName}`
 48:           );
 49:         }
 50:       });
 51:       console.log("\n=== SELECTABLE ITEMS CHECK ===");
 52:       modelConfig.selectableItems.forEach((item, index) => {
 53:         console.log(`Selectable Item ${index}: ${item.id} (${item.type})`);
 54:         console.log(`  Geometries count: ${item.geometries?.length || 0}`);
 55:         if (item.geometries) {
 56:           item.geometries.forEach((geo, geoIndex) => {
 57:             const hasGeometry = nodes[geo.geometryName];
 58:             const hasMaterial = materials[geo.materialName];
 59:             console.log(`    Part ${geoIndex}:`);
 60:             console.log(
 61:               `      Geometry '${geo.geometryName}': ${
 62:                 hasGeometry ? "✓ Found" : "✗ MISSING"
 63:               }`
 64:             );
 65:             console.log(
 66:               `      Material '${geo.materialName}': ${
 67:                 hasMaterial ? "✓ Found" : "✗ MISSING"
 68:               }`
 69:             );
 70:             if (!hasGeometry) {
 71:               console.warn(
 72:                 `Missing geometry for selectable item part: ${item.id} -> ${geo.geometryName}`
 73:               );
 74:             }
 75:             if (!hasMaterial) {
 76:               console.warn(
 77:                 `Missing material for selectable item part: ${item.id} -> ${geo.materialName}`
 78:               );
 79:             }
 80:           });
 81:         }
 82:       });
 83:       console.log("\n=== SAMPLE AVAILABLE NODES ===");
 84:       Object.keys(nodes)
 85:         .slice(0, 10)
 86:         .forEach((key) => {
 87:           console.log(`Node: ${key}`, nodes[key]);
 88:         });
 89:       console.log("\n=== SAMPLE AVAILABLE MATERIALS ===");
 90:       Object.keys(materials)
 91:         .slice(0, 10)
 92:         .forEach((key) => {
 93:           console.log(`Material: ${key}`, materials[key]);
 94:         });
 95:     }
 96:   }, [nodes, materials, modelConfig, enableDebug]);
 97:   const handleClick = useCallback(
 98:     (itemId) => (e) => {
 99:       e.stopPropagation();
100:       if (onItemClicked) {
101:         onItemClicked(itemId);
102:       }
103:       if (window.ReactNativeWebView && window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage) {
104:         window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage(
105:           JSON.stringify({ type: "itemClicked", id: itemId })
106:         );
107:       }
108:     },
109:     [onItemClicked]
110:   );
111:   const prepareItemGeometries = (item) => {
112:     if (!item.geometries) {
113:       if (enableDebug) {
114:         console.warn(`Item ${item.id} has no geometries array`);
115:       }
116:       return [];
117:     }
118:     return item.geometries
119:       .map((geoConfig) => {
120:         const geometry = nodes[geoConfig.geometryName];
121:         const material = materials[geoConfig.materialName];
122:         if (!geometry || !material) {
123:           if (enableDebug) {
124:             console.warn(
125:               `Skipping geometry part for item ${item.id}: missing ${
126:                 !geometry ? "geometry" : "material"
127:               } (${geoConfig.geometryName} -> ${geoConfig.materialName})`
128:             );
129:           }
130:           return null;
131:         }
132:         return {
133:           geometry: geometry.geometry,
134:           material: material,
135:           geometryName: geoConfig.geometryName,
136:           materialName: geoConfig.materialName,
137:         };
138:       })
139:       .filter(Boolean);
140:   };
141:   return (
142:     <group ref={groupRef} {...props}>
143:       {}
144:       <Effects
145:         selectedItems={selectedItems}
146:         occupiedItems={occupiedItems}
147:         selectionColor={modelConfig.selectionColor}
148:         occupiedColor={modelConfig.occupiedColor}
149:       />
150:       {}
151:       {modelConfig.staticItems.map((item) => {
152:         const geometry = nodes[item.geometryName];
153:         const material = materials[item.materialName];
154:         if (!geometry || !material) {
155:           if (enableDebug) {
156:             console.warn(
157:               `Skipping static item ${item.name}: missing ${
158:                 !geometry ? "geometry" : "material"
159:               }`
160:             );
161:           }
162:           return null;
163:         }
164:         return (
165:           <mesh
166:             key={item.name}
167:             geometry={geometry.geometry}
168:             material={material}
169:             castShadow
170:             receiveShadow
171:           />
172:         );
173:       })}
174:       {}
175:       {modelConfig.selectableItems.map((item) => {
176:         const selected = selectedItems.includes(item.id);
177:         const occupied = occupiedItems.includes(item.id);
178:         const geometries = prepareItemGeometries(item);
179:         if (geometries.length === 0) {
180:           if (enableDebug) {
181:             console.warn(
182:               `Skipping selectable item ${item.id}: no valid geometries`
183:             );
184:           }
185:           return null;
186:         }
187:         return (
188:           <SelectableItem
189:             key={item.id}
190:             itemConfig={item}
191:             geometries={geometries}
192:             materials={materials}
193:             modelConfig={modelConfig}
194:             selected={selected}
195:             occupied={occupied}
196:             onPointerOver={() => handlePointerOver(item.id, occupiedItems)}
197:             onPointerOut={handlePointerOut}
198:             onClick={handleClick(item.id)}
199:             clock={clock.current}
200:           />
201:         );
202:       })}
203:     </group>
204:   );
205: }
206: export const preloadModel = (modelConfig) => {
207:   useGLTF.preload(modelConfig.modelPath);
208: };

================
File: src/components/Model/SelectableItem.js
================
  1: import React, { useRef, useEffect } from "react";
  2: import { useFrame } from "@react-three/fiber";
  3: const SelectableItem = ({
  4:   itemConfig,
  5:   geometries,
  6:   materials,
  7:   modelConfig,
  8:   selected,
  9:   occupied,
 10:   onPointerOver,
 11:   onPointerOut,
 12:   onClick,
 13:   clock,
 14: }) => {
 15:   const groupRef = useRef();
 16:   const meshRefs = useRef([]);
 17:   const { id } = itemConfig;
 18:   const emissiveMaterials = geometries.map(({ materialName }) => {
 19:     const baseMaterial = materials[materialName];
 20:     return {
 21:       selected: modelConfig.createEmissiveMaterial(
 22:         baseMaterial,
 23:         modelConfig.selectionColor
 24:       ),
 25:       occupied: modelConfig.createEmissiveMaterial(
 26:         baseMaterial,
 27:         modelConfig.occupiedColor
 28:       ),
 29:       original: baseMaterial,
 30:     };
 31:   });
 32:   useEffect(() => {
 33:     meshRefs.current.forEach((meshRef, index) => {
 34:       if (!meshRef.current) return;
 35:       const materialSet = emissiveMaterials[index];
 36:       if (!materialSet) return;
 37:       if (selected) {
 38:         meshRef.current.material = materialSet.selected;
 39:       } else if (occupied) {
 40:         meshRef.current.material = materialSet.occupied;
 41:       } else {
 42:         meshRef.current.material = materialSet.original;
 43:         if (meshRef.current) {
 44:           meshRef.current.scale.set(1, 1, 1);
 45:         }
 46:       }
 47:     });
 48:   }, [selected, occupied, emissiveMaterials]);
 49:   useFrame(() => {
 50:     if (selected && groupRef.current) {
 51:       const elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime();
 52:       const intensity =
 53:         modelConfig.emissiveIntensity *
 54:         (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(elapsed * modelConfig.animationSpeed));
 55:       meshRefs.current.forEach((meshRef) => {
 56:         if (meshRef.current && meshRef.current.material.emissive) {
 57:           meshRef.current.material.emissiveIntensity = intensity;
 58:         }
 59:       });
 60:     } else if (occupied && groupRef.current) {
 61:       meshRefs.current.forEach((meshRef) => {
 62:         if (meshRef.current && meshRef.current.material.emissive) {
 63:           meshRef.current.material.emissiveIntensity =
 64:             modelConfig.emissiveIntensity * 0.7;
 65:         }
 66:       });
 67:     }
 68:   });
 69:   useEffect(() => {
 70:     meshRefs.current = meshRefs.current.slice(0, geometries.length);
 71:     while (meshRefs.current.length < geometries.length) {
 72:       meshRefs.current.push(React.createRef());
 73:     }
 74:   }, [geometries.length]);
 75:   return (
 76:     <group
 77:       ref={groupRef}
 78:       onPointerOver={onPointerOver}
 79:       onPointerOut={onPointerOut}
 80:       onClick={onClick}
 81:       name={id}
 82:     >
 83:       {geometries.map((geometryConfig, index) => {
 84:         if (!geometryConfig.geometry || !geometryConfig.material) {
 85:           return null;
 86:         }
 87:         return (
 88:           <mesh
 89:             key={`${id}-${index}`}
 90:             ref={meshRefs.current[index]}
 91:             geometry={geometryConfig.geometry}
 92:             material={geometryConfig.material}
 93:             name={`${id}-part-${index}`}
 94:             castShadow
 95:             receiveShadow
 96:           />
 97:         );
 98:       })}
 99:     </group>
100:   );
101: };
102: export default SelectableItem;

================
File: src/components/Scene.js
================
  1: import React from "react";
  2: import { Canvas } from "@react-three/fiber";
  3: import { Sky, Bvh, OrbitControls, Environment } from "@react-three/drei";
  4: import { Selection } from "@react-three/postprocessing";
  5: import { GenericModel } from "./Model/GenericModel";
  6: import * as THREE from "three";
  7: export function Scene({
  8:   modelConfig,
  9:   selectedItems,
 10:   occupiedItems,
 11:   onItemClicked,
 12:   sceneStyle,
 13:   enableDebug = false,
 14: }) {
 15:   const defaultStyle = {
 16:     width: "375px",
 17:     height: "667px",
 18:     margin: "0 auto",
 19:     borderRadius: "15px",
 20:     boxShadow: "0 15px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)",
 21:     background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f5f5, #eaeaea)",
 22:     border: "1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)",
 23:   };
 24:   const canvasStyle = { ...defaultStyle, ...sceneStyle };
 25:   return (
 26:     <Canvas
 27:       style={canvasStyle}
 28:       flat={false}
 29:       dpr={[1, 1.5]}
 30:       gl={{
 31:         antialias: true,
 32:         toneMapping: THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping,
 33:         toneMappingExposure: 1.0,
 34:         outputColorSpace: THREE.SRGBColorSpace,
 35:       }}
 36:       camera={{
 37:         position: modelConfig.initialCameraPosition,
 38:         fov: modelConfig.cameraFov,
 39:       }}
 40:       shadows
 41:     >
 42:       {}
 43:       <ambientLight intensity={0.4} color="#ffffff" />
 44:       {}
 45:       <directionalLight
 46:         position={[10, 10, 5]}
 47:         intensity={1}
 48:         color="#ffffff"
 49:         castShadow
 50:         shadow-mapSize-width={2048}
 51:         shadow-mapSize-height={2048}
 52:         shadow-camera-far={50}
 53:         shadow-camera-left={-20}
 54:         shadow-camera-right={20}
 55:         shadow-camera-top={20}
 56:         shadow-camera-bottom={-20}
 57:       />
 58:       {}
 59:       <directionalLight
 60:         position={[-5, 5, -5]}
 61:         intensity={0.3}
 62:         color="#ffffff"
 63:       />
 64:       {}
 65:       <directionalLight
 66:         position={[0, 5, -10]}
 67:         intensity={0.2}
 68:         color="#f0f8ff"
 69:       />
 70:       {}
 71:       <Environment preset="apartment" background={false} />
 72:       {}
 73:       <Sky
 74:         distance={450000}
 75:         sunPosition={[0, 1, 0]}
 76:         inclination={0}
 77:         azimuth={0.25}
 78:       />
 79:       <Bvh firstHitOnly>
 80:         <Selection>
 81:           <GenericModel
 82:             rotation={[0, 0, 0]}
 83:             position={[-0.8, 0, 0]}
 84:             modelConfig={modelConfig}
 85:             selectedItems={selectedItems}
 86:             occupiedItems={occupiedItems}
 87:             onItemClicked={onItemClicked}
 88:             enableDebug={enableDebug}
 89:           />
 90:         </Selection>
 91:       </Bvh>
 92:       <OrbitControls
 93:         target={modelConfig.cameraTarget}
 94:         enableZoom={true}
 95:         enablePan={true}
 96:         enableRotate={true}
 97:         panSpeed={1}
 98:         zoomSpeed={1.5}
 99:         rotateSpeed={1.2}
100:         screenSpacePanning={true}
101:         touchPan={1}
102:         touchRotate={2}
103:         touchZoom={2}
104:         minDistance={5}
105:         maxDistance={50}
106:       />
107:     </Canvas>
108:   );
109: }
110: export default Scene;

================
File: src/configs/ModelConfig.js
================
 1: import * as THREE from "three";
 2: export class RestaurantModelConfig {
 3:   constructor({
 4:     modelPath,
 5:     initialCameraPosition = [0, 10, 0],
 6:     cameraFov = 40,
 7:     cameraTarget = [0, 0, 0],
 8:     selectableItems = [],
 9:     staticItems = [],
10:     selectionColor = new THREE.Color(0x00ff00),
11:     occupiedColor = new THREE.Color(0xff0000),
12:     emissiveIntensity = 0.5,
13:     animationSpeed = 8,
14:     animationScale = 0.05,
15:   }) {
16:     this.modelPath = modelPath;
17:     this.initialCameraPosition = initialCameraPosition;
18:     this.cameraFov = cameraFov;
19:     this.cameraTarget = cameraTarget;
20:     this.selectableItems = selectableItems;
21:     this.staticItems = staticItems;
22:     this.selectionColor = selectionColor;
23:     this.occupiedColor = occupiedColor;
24:     this.emissiveIntensity = emissiveIntensity;
25:     this.animationSpeed = animationSpeed;
26:     this.animationScale = animationScale;
27:   }
28:   createEmissiveMaterial(baseMaterial, emissiveColor) {
29:     if (!baseMaterial) return null;
30:     const clonedMaterial = baseMaterial.clone();
31:     clonedMaterial.emissive = emissiveColor;
32:     clonedMaterial.emissiveIntensity = this.emissiveIntensity;
33:     clonedMaterial.toneMapped = false;
34:     return clonedMaterial;
35:   }
36: }

1: import { kitchenModelConfig } from "./KitchenModelConfig.js";

================
File: src/context/ModelProvider.js
================
  1: import React, {
  2:   createContext,
  3:   useState,
  4:   useContext,
  5:   useEffect,
  6:   useCallback,
  7: } from "react";
  8: import { useGLTF } from "@react-three/drei";
  9: import { modelRegistry } from "../configs/ModelRegistry";
 10: const ModelContext = createContext(null);
 11: export const ModelProvider = ({ children, initialModelKey = "kitchen" }) => {
 12:   const [currentModelKey, setCurrentModelKey] = useState(initialModelKey);
 13:   const [modelConfig, setModelConfig] = useState(
 14:     modelRegistry[initialModelKey]
 15:   );
 16:   const [selectedItems, setSelectedItems] = useState([]);
 17:   const [occupiedItems, setOccupiedItems] = useState([
 18:     "CHAIR03_TABLE05",
 19:     "CHAIR02_TABLE05",
 20:   ]);
 21:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
 22:   useGLTF.preload(modelConfig?.modelPath);
 23:   useEffect(() => {
 24:     const config = modelRegistry[currentModelKey];
 25:     if (config) {
 26:       setModelConfig(config);
 27:       setIsLoading(true);
 28:       useGLTF.preload(config.modelPath, () => {
 29:         setIsLoading(false);
 30:       });
 31:       setSelectedItems([]);
 32:     } else {
 33:       console.error(`Model configuration for "${currentModelKey}" not found`);
 34:     }
 35:   }, [currentModelKey]);
 36:   const changeModel = useCallback((modelKey) => {
 37:     if (modelRegistry[modelKey]) {
 38:       setCurrentModelKey(modelKey);
 39:     } else {
 40:       console.error(`Model "${modelKey}" not found in registry`);
 41:     }
 42:   }, []);
 43:   const toggleItemSelection = useCallback(
 44:     (itemId) => {
 45:       if (occupiedItems.includes(itemId)) {
 46:         return;
 47:       }
 48:       setSelectedItems((prev) => {
 49:         if (prev.includes(itemId)) {
 50:           return prev.filter((id) => id !== itemId);
 51:         } else {
 52:           return [...prev, itemId];
 53:         }
 54:       });
 55:     },
 56:     [occupiedItems]
 57:   );
 58:   const setItemsAsOccupied = useCallback((itemIds) => {
 59:     if (!Array.isArray(itemIds)) {
 60:       itemIds = [itemIds];
 61:     }
 62:     setSelectedItems((prev) => prev.filter((id) => !itemIds.includes(id)));
 63:     setOccupiedItems((prev) => {
 64:       const newOccupied = [...prev];
 65:       itemIds.forEach((id) => {
 66:         if (!newOccupied.includes(id)) {
 67:           newOccupied.push(id);
 68:         }
 69:       });
 70:       return newOccupied;
 71:     });
 72:   }, []);
 73:   const clearOccupancy = useCallback((itemIds) => {
 74:     if (!Array.isArray(itemIds)) {
 75:       itemIds = [itemIds];
 76:     }
 77:     setOccupiedItems((prev) => prev.filter((id) => !itemIds.includes(id)));
 78:   }, []);
 79:   const availableItems =
 80:     modelConfig?.selectableItems.map((item) => item.id) || [];
 81:   const contextValue = {
 82:     currentModelKey,
 83:     modelConfig,
 84:     isLoading,
 85:     selectedItems,
 86:     occupiedItems,
 87:     availableItems,
 88:     changeModel,
 89:     toggleItemSelection,
 90:     setSelectedItems,
 91:     setOccupiedItems,
 92:     setItemsAsOccupied,
 93:     clearOccupancy,
 94:   };
 95:   return (
 96:     <ModelContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
 97:       {children}
 98:     </ModelContext.Provider>
 99:   );
100: };
101: export const useModel = () => {
102:   const context = useContext(ModelContext);
103:   if (!context) {
104:     throw new Error("useModel must be used within a ModelProvider");
105:   }
106:   return context;
107: };

================
File: src/hooks/useContentHeight.js
================
 1: import { useEffect } from "react";
 2: export const useContentHeight = () => {
 3:   useEffect(() => {
 4:     const postMessageToRN = (message) => {
 5:       if (window.ReactNativeWebView && window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage) {
 6:         window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage(JSON.stringify(message));
 7:       }
 8:     };
 9:     const sendHeight = () => {
10:       const height = document.body.scrollHeight;
11:       postMessageToRN({ type: "contentHeight", height });
12:     };
13:     sendHeight();
14:     window.addEventListener("resize", sendHeight);
15:     const observer = new MutationObserver(sendHeight);
16:     observer.observe(document.body, {
17:       childList: true,
18:       subtree: true,
19:       attributes: true,
20:     });
21:     return () => {
22:       window.removeEventListener("resize", sendHeight);
23:       observer.disconnect();
24:     };
25:   }, []);
26: };

================
File: src/hooks/useDebouncedHover.js
================
 1: import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
 2: import { debounce } from "lodash";
 3: const useDebouncedHover = (delay = 30) => {
 4:   const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(null);
 5:   const debouncedSetHovered = useCallback(
 6:     (name) => {
 7:       debounce(() => {
 8:         setHovered(name);
 9:       }, delay)();
10:     },
11:     [delay]
12:   );
13:   const handlePointerOver = useCallback(
14:     (name, occupiedChairs) => (e) => {
15:       e.stopPropagation();
16:       if (occupiedChairs.includes(name)) return;
17:       debouncedSetHovered(name);
18:     },
19:     [debouncedSetHovered]
20:   );
21:   const handlePointerOut = useCallback(() => {
22:     debouncedSetHovered(null);
23:   }, [debouncedSetHovered]);
24:   return {
25:     hovered,
26:     handlePointerOver,
27:     handlePointerOut,
28:   };
29: };
30: export default useDebouncedHover;

================
File: src/hooks/useReactNativeMessaging.js
================
 1: import { useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
 2: export const useReactNativeMessaging = (setSelectedItems, setOccupiedItems) => {
 3:   const postMessageToRN = useCallback((message) => {
 4:     if (window.ReactNativeWebView && window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage) {
 5:       window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage(JSON.stringify(message));
 6:     }
 7:   }, []);
 8:   const notifyInteractionStart = useCallback(() => {
 9:     postMessageToRN({ type: "interactionStart" });
10:   }, [postMessageToRN]);
11:   const notifyInteractionEnd = useCallback(() => {
12:     postMessageToRN({ type: "interactionEnd" });
13:   }, [postMessageToRN]);
14:   useEffect(() => {
15:     window.updateItems = ({
16:       selectedItems: selected,
17:       occupiedItems: occupied,
18:     }) => {
19:       if (Array.isArray(selected)) {
20:         setSelectedItems(selected);
21:       }
22:       if (Array.isArray(occupied)) {
23:         setOccupiedItems(occupied);
24:       }
25:     };
26:     postMessageToRN({
27:       type: "webViewReady",
28:     });
29:     return () => {
30:       delete window.updateItems;
31:     };
32:   }, [setSelectedItems, setOccupiedItems, postMessageToRN]);
33:   return {
34:     postMessageToRN,
35:     notifyInteractionStart,
36:     notifyInteractionEnd,
37:   };
38: };

================
File: src/App.js
================
  1: import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
  2: import { Scene } from "./components/Scene";
  3: import { useReactNativeMessaging } from "./hooks/useReactNativeMessaging";
  4: import { useContentHeight } from "./hooks/useContentHeight";
  5: import { ModelProvider, useModel } from "./context/ModelProvider";
  6: function App() {
  7:   return (
  8:     <ModelProvider initialModelKey="cafe">
  9:       <RestaurantApp />
 10:     </ModelProvider>
 11:   );
 12: }
 13: function RestaurantApp() {
 14:   const {
 15:     modelConfig,
 16:     selectedItems,
 17:     occupiedItems,
 18:     setSelectedItems,
 19:     setOccupiedItems,
 20:     toggleItemSelection,
 21:     changeModel,
 22:   } = useModel();
 23:   const [debugMode, setDebugMode] = useState(false);
 24:   const { notifyInteractionStart, notifyInteractionEnd, postMessageToRN } =
 25:     useReactNativeMessaging(setSelectedItems, setOccupiedItems);
 26:   useContentHeight();
 27:   const handleItemClicked = (itemId) => {
 28:     toggleItemSelection(itemId);
 29:   };
 30:   useEffect(() => {
 31:     window.changeRestaurantModel = (modelKey) => {
 32:       changeModel(modelKey);
 33:       postMessageToRN({
 34:         type: "modelChanged",
 35:         modelKey,
 36:         availableItems: modelConfig.selectableItems.map((item) => item.id),
 37:       });
 38:     };
 39:     window.toggleDebugMode = () => {
 40:       setDebugMode((prev) => !prev);
 41:       console.log(`Debug mode ${!debugMode ? "enabled" : "disabled"}`);
 42:     };
 43:     window.logModelState = () => {
 44:       console.log("Current Model State:", {
 45:         modelKey: modelConfig.modelPath,
 46:         selectedItems,
 47:         occupiedItems,
 48:         availableItems: modelConfig.selectableItems.map((item) => item.id),
 49:       });
 50:     };
 51:     return () => {
 52:       delete window.changeRestaurantModel;
 53:       delete window.toggleDebugMode;
 54:       delete window.logModelState;
 55:     };
 56:   }, [
 57:     changeModel,
 58:     modelConfig,
 59:     postMessageToRN,
 60:     debugMode,
 61:     selectedItems,
 62:     occupiedItems,
 63:   ]);
 64:   return (
 65:     <div
 66:       style={{ width: "100%" }}
 67:       onTouchStart={notifyInteractionStart}
 68:       onTouchEnd={notifyInteractionEnd}
 69:       onMouseDown={notifyInteractionStart}
 70:       onMouseUp={notifyInteractionEnd}
 71:     >
 72:       {}
 73:       {debugMode && (
 74:         <div
 75:           style={{
 76:             position: "absolute",
 77:             top: 10,
 78:             left: 10,
 79:             zIndex: 1000,
 80:             background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.8)",
 81:             color: "white",
 82:             padding: "10px",
 83:             borderRadius: "5px",
 84:             fontSize: "12px",
 85:           }}
 86:         >
 87:           <div>Debug Mode Active</div>
 88:           <div>Selected: {selectedItems.join(", ") || "None"}</div>
 89:           <div>Occupied: {occupiedItems.join(", ") || "None"}</div>
 90:           <button
 91:             onClick={() => window.logModelState()}
 92:             style={{ marginTop: "5px", fontSize: "10px" }}
 93:           >
 94:             Log State
 95:           </button>
 96:         </div>
 97:       )}
 98:       <Scene
 99:         modelConfig={modelConfig}
100:         selectedItems={selectedItems}
101:         occupiedItems={occupiedItems}
102:         onItemClicked={handleItemClicked}
103:       />
104:     </div>
105:   );
106: }
107: export default App;

 1: const reportWebVitals = onPerfEntry => {
 2:   if (onPerfEntry && onPerfEntry instanceof Function) {
 3:     import('web-vitals').then(({ getCLS, getFID, getFCP, getLCP, getTTFB }) => {
 4:       getCLS(onPerfEntry);
 5:       getFID(onPerfEntry);
 6:       getFCP(onPerfEntry);
 7:       getLCP(onPerfEntry);
 8:       getTTFB(onPerfEntry);
 9:     });
10:   }
11: };
